Page 001
001-1. QIMANGA.COM
001-2. ARE YOU SURE? THAT THEY WANT TO BUY OUR PAINTINGS? DOTHEY EVEN HAVE THE MEANS?
001-3. IT APPEARS SO.
001-4. SECRETARY SONG
001-5. ACCORDING TO OUR NEW YORK BRANCH,WENTWORTHART GALLERY HAS FOUND A MASSIVE SPONSOR,
001-6. AND GALLERIES AROUND THE WORLD ARE RECEIVING EMAILS FROM WENTWORTH
001-7. CONTAINING A LIST OF ARTWORKS FROMTHEIR COLLECTIONS THAT THEY WISH TO PURCHASE.
001-8. THEN ISN'T THAT FINE?
001-9. BUT SOME OF THE ITEMS ON THIS LIST HAVE ALREADY BEEN SECRETLY SOLD...
001-10. aVS

Page 002
002-1. I KNOW. SO MAKE A NEW LIST WITH WHAT WE ACTUALLY HAVE. PICK OUT THE VALUABLE ONES.
002-2. YES.
002-3. AND GO MEET THAT PORTER OR WHATEVER WHO SENT THE EMAIL IN PERSON.
002-4. SEE IF THEY'LL ACCEPT OUR CONDITIONS OR NOT. ORNOT
002-5. YES, MADAM CHAIRWOMAN.
002-6. QIMANGA.COM
002-7. A PERFECT CASH COW APPEARED JUST WHEN WE NEEDED MONEY ANYWAY.
002-8. WENTWORTH ART GALLERY

Page 003
003-1. I HAVE BEEN EXPECTING YOU, MR. SONG.
003-2. HOW WAS YOUR FLIGHT?
003-3. IT WAS GOOD. THANK YOU FOR SUCH A WARM WELCOME.
003-4. I DIDN'T EXPECT SUNYANG GALLERY TO RESPOND SO QUICKLY...
003-5. QIMANCA.COM
003-6. IS IT BECAUSE OF THE COMPLICATED SITUATION HE MENTIONED?
003-7. YOU ARE QUITE AGGRESSIVE WITH YOUR ARTWORK PURCHASES.
003-8. IS THAT THE GALLERY'S POLICY?
003-9. RATHER THAN A POLICY, IT WOULD BE MORE ACCURATE TO SAY WE ARE BEING REBORN.
003-10. A FULL-FLEDGED SPONSOR HAS APPEARED.
003-11. COULD YOU PERHAPS TELL ME WHO THIS SPONSOR IS?

Page 004
004-1. UNFORTUNATELY, I CANNOT DISCLOSE THAT.
004-2. HOW STRANGE. THE ONE PURCHASING THE PAINTINGS IS OUR GALLERY, NOT THE SPONSOR.
004-3. AH, MY APOLOGIES.
004-4. IT IS ACTUALLY BECAUSE SUNYANG GALLERY HAS ONLY EVER SOLD ARTWORKS TO INDIVIDUALS.
004-5. ISN'T IT A WELL-KNOWNFACT THAT THE GALLERY'S MAIN CLIENTS ARE INDIVIDUALS?
004-6. ARE YOU PERHAPS THINKING OF TRADING WITH THE SPONSOR THROUGH US?
004-7. FORGIVE ME FOR BEING FORWARD, BUT YES.
004-8. WOULD THAT BE POSSIBLE?
004-9. BY ANY CHANCE.. DOES THIS MEAN THE PAINTINGS CANNOT BE SHOWN TO THE PUBLIC,
004-10. AND THE TRANSACTION ITSELF MUST BE KEPT A SECRET?
004-11. EXACTLY.
004-12. THAT IS THE KIND OF TRANSACTION WE WANT.
004-13. IT IS ALSO A COMMON CONDITION IN PRIVATE TRANSACTIONS.
004-14. QIMANGA.COM
004-15. COUNTLESS ARTWORKS DISAPPEAR LIKE THIS.
004-16. THEN EVEN IF OUR GALLERY PURCHASES THEM,
004-17. AS LONG AS WE KEEP THOSE CONDITIONS, IT WON'T BE AN ISSUE, RIGHT?

Page 005
005-1. THAT IS TRUE, BUT
005-2. WOULD A GALLERY BE ABLE TO KEEP THEM FROM THE PUBLIC?
005-3. WE WOULD HAVE TO DISCUSS IT WITH THE BOARD, BUT IT ISN'T IMPOSSIBLE.
005-4. THE ARTWORKS SUNYANG GALLERY HOLDS ARE MASTERPIECES.
005-5. IF WE CONSIDER THEIR PRESERVATION, IT MIGHT BE POSSIBLE..
005-6. WOULD YOU TAKE A LOOK AT THIS?
005-7. SOME OF THE ARTWORKS YOU REQUESTED ARE PIECES WE CANNOT SELL,
005-8. SO I BROUGHT A LIST OF THE ONES AVAILABLE FOR PURCHASE.
005-9. PLEASE REVIEW IT.
005-10. THEN PLEASE CONTACT ME ONCE YOU REACH A DECISION. HOW LONG WILL IT TAKE?
005-11. I WILL LET YOU KNOW BY THE DAY AFTER TOMORROW AT THE LATEST.WOULD THAT BE ALRIGHT?
005-12. OF COURSE.
005-13. QIMANGA.COM

Page 006
006-1. SO THOSE WERE THE CONDITIONS AFTER ALL.
006-2. JUST HOW MANY ARTWORKS ARE STORED IN SUNYANG GALLERY'S VAULT?
006-3. ICAN GUARANTEE THAT THE TCANGUARANTEETHATTHE FEW PIECES WORTH HUNDREDS OF MILLIONSSHOWNBRIEFLYDURING SPECIAL EXHIBITIONS
006-4. ARE ALL THEY REALLY HAVE LEFT...
006-5. THEN HOW MUCH ARE THE ITEMS ON THIS LIST WORTH?
006-6. QIMANGA.COM
006-7. I HEARD THESE ARE THE ARTWORKS SUNYANG GALLERY CANNOT SELL, BUT...
006-8. OBVIOUSLY. OUT OF THE LIST OF SUNYANGGALLERY'S ARTWORKS THATDIRECTORWOOBYUNGJOON INVESTIGATED,
006-9. THESE ARE THE ONES LEFT AFTER EXCLUDING THE LIST GIVEN TO ELIZABETH PORTER AS TRADABLE.
006-10. STILL, I WOULD LIKE TO KNOW.

Page 007
007-1. IF THEY WERE PUT UP FOR AUCTION AT CHRISTIE'S RIGHT NOW,
007-2. NO ONE WOULD BE ABLE TO PREDICT THEIR WINNING BIDS.
007-3. IF THEY WERE ALL AUCTIONED OFF AT THE SAME TIME ON THE SAME DAY,
007-4. THE COMPETITIVE SPIRIT OF THE WORLD'S BILLIONAIRES WOULD IGNITE, AND THE PRICES WOULD SKYROCKET.
007-5. I DIDN'T ASK FOR AN EXACT PRICE.
007-6. JUST GIVE ME A ROUGH ESTIMATE.
007-7. ..AT LEAST
007-8. Z BILLION DOLLARS.
007-9. QIMANGA.COM
007-10. SINCE THEY HAVE PROBABLY ALREADY SOLD OFF A LOT OF THEM A LONG TIME AGO,
007-11. EVEN IF WE ONLY COUNT HALF, GRANDMOTHER HAS BURIED OVER 1 TRILLION WON IN STOCKS.
007-12. THEN HOW MUCH WOULD IT COST TO BUY ALL THE ARTWORKS SUNYANG GALLERY SAID WERE TRADABLE?
007-13. ALL OF THEM?
007-14. YES. THEY WILL OFFER A PRICE,OFCOURSE, BUT WE CAN'T JUST ACCEPT IT UNCONDITIONALLY, RIGHT?
007-15. SO WE NEED TO THINK OF THE MOST OPTIMAL AMOUNT THAT WON'T BREAK THE DEAL.

Page 008
008-1. 60O MILLION DOLLARS.
008-2. LET'S BUY THEM ALL.
008-3. QIMANGA.COM
008-4. WAIT A MINUTE, BETTE. THIS ISN'T A DONATION.
008-5. THE BUYER OF THE PAINTINGS WILL BE FANTASY OR ME.
008-6. IT WILL MERELY BE IN THE FORM OF A FREE LEASE TO THE WENTWORTH TO THE WENTWOKTH ART GALLERY.
008-7. WE NEED TO BE CLEAR ABOUT THIS.
008-8. OH MAN... EVEN IF OUR GALLERY RECEIVES THOSE ARTWORKS, WE CAN'T EXHIBIT THEM,SO
008-9. WHAT IS THE POINT OF ALL THIS?

Page 009
009-1. IT WILL BE 1 YEAR AT MOST.
009-2. AFTER 1 YEAR, I WILL MAKE IT SO THOSE ARTWORKS CAN BE REVEALED TO THE WORLD.
009-3. REALLY?
009-4. QIMANGA.COM
009-5. OF COURSE. BUT SHOULDN'T WE CLOSE THE DEAL BEFORE THAT?
009-6. IF WE ACCEPT THEIR CONDITIONS, THE DEAL IS AS GOOD AS DONE.
009-7. NO. WE HEARD THEIR CONDITIONS,
009-8. SO NOW WE HAVE TO PRESENT OURS.
009-9. HUH?
009-10. BETTE, HOW ARE SECRET TRANSACTIONS USUALLY HANDLED ONTHE BLACK MARKET?
009-11. ONCE THE ARTWORKIS APPRAISED AND CONFIRMED TO BE GENUINE, PAYMENT IS MADE INTHE MANNER THE SELLER WANTS.
009-12. WIRE TRANSFER FOR LARGE AMOUNTS, CASH IF NOT.
009-13. WHATABOUT A CONTRACT?
009-14. PfH.

Page 010
010-1. IT IS LITERALLY A BLACK MARKET.
010-2. THERE IS NO WAY SOMETHING LIKE A CONTRACT EXISTS.
010-3. DO YOU THINK SUNYANG GALLERY WILL TRADE LIKE IT'S A BLACK MARKET?
010-4. YES, SO THEY WILL AGREE TO ALMOST ANY CONDITION WE SET.
010-5. NO WAY! WHY WOULD A PLACE LIKE SUNYANG GALLERY DO SUCH A THING.?
010-6. I CAN UNDERSTAND NOT ALLOWING PUBLIC DISCLOSURE AND KEEPING THE CONTRACT DETAILS SECRET,
010-7. BUT THERE SHOULD BE NOREASONTO MAKE THE TRANSACTIONITSELF ILLEGAL, RIGHT?
010-8. HOWCOULDAWOMAN WHOHASLIVED HERWHOLE LIFE THINKINGONLYABOUTART
010-9. UNDERSTANDOUR FAMILY, A DEN OF MONSTERS UNLIKE ANY OTHER?
010-10. BETTE, EVEN IF YOU ARE CURIOUS, DON'T WASTE YOUR CURIOSITY ON UNNECESSARY THINGS.
010-11. QIMANGA.COM
010-12. YOU ONLY NEED TO THINK ABOUT WHAT YOU GAIN FROM THIS DEAL.

Page 011
011-1. 3 MILLION DOLLARS IN SPONSORSHIP EVERY YEAR.
011-2. AND MASTERPIECES THAT YOU MIGHT BE ABLE TO EXHIBIT FOREVER.
011-3. YOU SHOULDN'T LOSE THIS BECAUSE OF CURIOSITY, RIGHT?
011-4. QIMANGA.COM
011-5. NOW, HERE IS THE CONDITION WE WILL PRESENT.
011-6. WE WILL MAKE APPROPRIATE CONCESSIONS SO THEY CAN WORK COMFORTABLY.
011-7. WE CAN EVEN CONCEDE ON THE PRICE,
011-8. BUT THE ONE THING WE CAN NEVER BACK DOWN ON IS THE CONTRACT.
011-9. BUT...
011-10. BASED ON MY CURRENT EXPECTATIONS, I DON'T THINK THAT WILL BE POSSIBLE?
011-11. WITHOUT A CONTRACT, THERE IS NO DEAL.
011-12. ALSO, THAT CONTRACT MUST ABSOLUTELY HAVE THE SIGNATURE OF SUNYANG GALLERY'S TOP EXECUTIVE,
011-13. NOT THE NOMINAL GALLERY DIRECTOR,
011-14. BUT THE HANDWRITTEN SIGNATURE OF THE ACTUAL OWNER.

Page 012
012-1. THE ACTUAL OWNER?
012-2. WHO IS THAT?
012-3. THE CHAIRWOMAN OF THE CONGLOMERATE ARTS FOUNDATION.
012-4. ： :JP 工： ： JHS
